notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. CONFIRMED STUDIO RIG from Sound on Sound production article: nearly all guitar parts recorded using Kapranos's battered old Selmer valve combo amp and Hardy's Fender Bassman 100. No amp+cab model available for Selmer on Helix — the Selmer is a vintage British valve amp with EL84 power tubes, similar in character to a Vox AC30. EQ compensates for removed amp voicing. CRITICAL SONG NOTE: Take Me Out has a famous and deliberate tempo change — the angular intro riff is at approximately 104 BPM, and the main driving section kicks in at 133 BPM. Master BPM set to 133 (dominant section). Intro snapshot delay is set as a fixed ms value (345ms) since no note division lands cleanly at 104 BPM. Main riff and lead snapshot delays are tempo-synced to 133 BPM. Three snapshots: angular intro, driving main riff, and lead/solo. Deranged Master (Dallas Rangemaster Treble Booster) approximates Kapranos's confirmed Telenordia Treble Booster for main riff. Elephant Man (EHX Deluxe Memory Man) chosen for delay — its modulation approximates the wobbly character of Kapranos's confirmed Gurus Echosex 2 (Binson Echorec-style). RIG COMPENSATION UPDATE: Stupor OD added before Deranged Master to compensate for Lace Sensor lower output (vs Kapranos's hotter Creamery pickups) and Fender Super Champ XD higher clean headroom (vs Selmer valve combo natural breakup). Deranged Master Drive and Level increased for same reason. Parametric EQ Level raised to push tube amp input stage harder.
confirmed_sources: Sound on Sound — Recording Franz Ferdinand (Selmer amp + Fender Bassman 100)
Equipboard — Alex Kapranos gear (Telenordia Treble Booster, Gurus Echosex 2, Fender Hot Rod Deluxe live 2004)
Premier Guitar — Franz Ferdinand Spanners in the Works interview
Franz Ferdinand TikTok — G&L Legacy HSS guitar used in Take Me Out session
tempo_change_note: Take Me Out has a famous deliberate tempo change at approximately 0:53. The intro (Snapshot 1) is at ~104 BPM. The main section (Snapshots 2+3) is at ~133 BPM. Use tap tempo on the Helix to lock to each section. Master BPM is set to 133 for the main section — tap before Snapshot 1 to adjust intro delay if needed, or leave it as a fixed ms value.

signal_chain.notes: Intro snapshot most open — angular riff must decay naturally. Main riff and lead tighten as Stupor OD and Deranged Master generate more noise.

Added to compensate for Lace Sensor lower output and Super Champ XD higher clean headroom vs Kapranos's confirmed rig. Simulates the natural valve breakup the Selmer combo would have provided at volume. Drive kept low in all snapshots — this is not an obvious overdrive effect, just a foundation of saturation. ACTIVE in all three snapshots with progressively increasing Drive.

Confirmed: Kapranos uses a Telenordia Treble Booster on his 2022 live rig. Deranged Master (Dallas Rangemaster) is the closest available model. WARNING from YAML: 'Like the real thing, this model can take your head off! Works best before a distorted amp.' BYPASSED in Snapshot 1 (intro riff is cleaner and more angular). ACTIVE in Snapshots 2 and 3. Drive and Level pushed harder than initial version to compensate for Lace Sensor lower output and Super Champ XD clean headroom.

Compensates for removed Selmer valve amp voicing. Level raised significantly from initial version to push Super Champ XD input stage harder, encouraging natural preamp breakup. Mid boost at 800-900Hz adds the angular, percussive Selmer midrange character. Intro uses more open voicing — brighter and more jangly.

Chosen for Mode and Depth parameters which approximate the Gurus Echosex 2 / Binson Echorec wobbly character. Kapranos described the Echosex as having 'a bit of wobble in it as if like you've got a wonky wheel on the original.' Mode Chorus, Depth at low values adds subtle pitch modulation to repeats. S1: FIXED 345ms — no note division lands cleanly at 104 BPM. S2: 1/8 synced to 133 BPM (226ms, 0.6ms off). S3: d1/8 synced to 133 BPM (338ms, 0.3ms off). Unchanged from initial version.
Room Size FIXED at 15m — do NOT make snapshot-variable, causes audible algorithm bump. Unchanged from initial version — reverb settings were correct.

1_angular_intro.description: Angular intro at ~104 BPM. Stupor OD at Drive 3.0. Deranged Master bypassed. Gate -65dB. EQ Level +2dB. Fixed 345ms delay, Depth 1.5. Reverb 1.5 sec, 28% mix. Switch to FS2 at tempo change around 0:53.

2_main_riff.description: Main section at 133 BPM. Stupor OD Drive 4.5. Deranged Master active at Drive 6.5, Treble 7.5, Level 6.5 — pushed hard to drive Super Champ XD into natural breakup. EQ Level +4dB. Eighth note delay (226ms, 22% mix). Tight reverb (0.7 sec, 12% mix).

3_lead.description: Lead passages. Stupor OD Drive 5.5. Deranged Master Drive 7.5, Treble 8.0, Level 7.0. EQ Level +4dB. Dotted eighth delay (338ms, 38% mix), Depth 1.8. Reverb 1.8 sec, 32% mix.

playing_notes.tempo_change_technique: Switch from Snapshot 1 to Snapshot 2 exactly on the first downbeat of the main riff at 0:53. The Stupor OD increasing plus Deranged Master engaging simultaneously reinforces the dramatic tonal and rhythmic shift.
playing_notes.pickup_notes: Bridge pickup throughout Snapshots 1 and 2. Bridge or neck for Snapshot 3.
playing_notes.rig_compensation: The Stupor OD at Drive 3.0-5.5 and the higher Deranged Master settings compensate for two rig-specific factors: Lace Sensor lower output vs Kapranos's Creamery custom pickups, and Super Champ XD higher clean headroom vs the Selmer valve combo's natural breakup. If still too clean, raise amp physical volume — the Deranged Master responds best when power tubes are working moderately hard.
playing_notes.further_adjustments: If still too clean after this version: (1) raise amp physical volume, (2) raise Stupor OD Drive by 1.0 per snapshot, (3) raise Parametric EQ Level by a further +2dB. If it becomes too harsh or spiky: pull Deranged Master Treble back toward 7.0 and reduce Stupor OD Drive by 0.5.
playing_notes.elephant_man_wobble: Elephant Man Depth at 1.2-1.8 in Chorus mode adds barely perceptible pitch fluctuation — the Echorec wonky-wheel character. Should feel organic rather than obvious.
playing_notes.deranged_master_warning: YAML notes: 'Like the real thing, this model can take your head off!' At Drive 6.5-7.5 it will be aggressive. The Bass at 3.0 is critical — it rolls off low end that would otherwise become muddy. If the tone is too bright or spiky, reduce Treble before reducing Drive.
